newsitem.title: USA: Community Bank System sets 2-for-1 split.
newsitem.headline: Community Bank System sets 2-for-1 split.

text.p: Community Bank System Inc said Monday its board of directors approved a 2-for-1 stock split.

The split is subject to shareholders' approval of the authorization of the additional shares needed to complete the split. If approved, the new shares would be distributed on or about March 12 to shareholders of record on February 10.
The company said it scheduled a shareholder meeting for February 19 to seek an increase in the number of authorized common shares to 20 million from 5 million.
